verdict.rationale: Ashby documents a report builder with customizable templates for custom reports (ashby-docs-18). Getting data out to a warehouse is only possible through its general-purpose API, using paginated list endpoints and sync tokens for incremental application pulls (ashby-docs-8, ashby-docs-9), plus webhooks for event streams (ashby-docs-6), so an analyst would need to build their own pipeline. Missing for 10: scheduled report exports, native BI/warehouse connectors, a dedicated documented reporting/analytics API, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
